articles.title: Bitap: my favorite string matching algorithm

It is particularly useful when the pattern is relatively short and the string is relatively large. The algorithm is simple to understand and implement, and it is relatively efficient for short strings. Unlike more complex algorithms like Boyer-Moore or Knuth-Morris-Pratt, the bitap algorithm uses bit operations in a very elegant fashion, making it a great choice for developers who want to optimize their string matching code.

articles.title: I've factored the RSA keys of a Certificate Authority from the 90s

The RSA factoring challenge was deprecated in 2020, and even the largest factorization, of 862-bit RSA-260, was achieved just a few days ago. The RSA keys in question were shipped with Netscape SSL support in 1994 and Internet Explorer shortly afterwards, and were trusted for SSL and S/MIME certificates. Factoring the public keys in the root certificates will give the private keys needed to reconstruct the private key, which can be used to issue certificates.
